texts.f67128898e39: To test the following questions relating to the treatment of children with Acute Lymphoblastic Leukaemia (ALL). Randomised. (1) Can treatment be reduced without compromising efficacy in a MRF-defined low risk group. (2) Does further post-remission intensification improve outcome for a MRD- defined high risk group. (3) What is the effect of treatment on childrens quality of  life. NON Randomised. What is the frequency of sensitsation to asparaginase and its impact of effiacy to a second exposure to the drug.
